scenario: [LGRA.2.8.2]: a `cooldown` written as a `time` const of zero is `cooldown 0_s`, which [LCDB.5.6] makes legal: a tracker whose window is zero always permits. `r cooldown W`, `const W = 0_s`, logs `t.n`. Pin: set 0; assert Trig k=1 n=0; pump (`fire 0`); set n=1, a mutable-slot change under the same key, so a new match with the same activation key ([LCDB.3.3.1]), with no time passing; pump (`fire 1`). Messages are exactly ['fire 0', 'fire 1']. A const refused as a zero window, as a `within` is, fails the compile; one lowered to any positive window suppresses the second firing and logs ['fire 0']. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete.lgra_2_8_2_rate_window_ns` keeping its own `>= 0` over `dsc.dstest.lgra_2_8_1_time_expr_ns`, then `FN_RATE_ALLOW` with `cool_ns` 0 on the fire guard, in both runtimes.
